about: P2-S8-T03 (09 S8, S13 'Axe / Pa11y over a fixed page sample'; 14 Phase 2 exit criterion 8). The eight archetype pages the accessibility harness, site/tests/a11y.spec.ts, audits with axe-core and with pa11y, each in the four modes below: one fixed page per archetype, so a run is comparable with the last. Each names the route family of scripts/route_groups.json its page belongs to, and the page must carry that family's fallback element as scripts/route_fallback_map.json names it, plus any element in `requires`, so an archetype cannot drift onto a page that is not what it says. A route that is not built, or a family the page does not belong to, fails the harness. 'contribute' has no page of its own: 10's URL scheme names no /contribute/ route and the contribution path ends in GitHub's issue form, which is not this site's to audit, so the archetype is the on-site contribution surface, 09 S6.14's Contribute block and the field-level 'correct' links, read on the record page family the other seven do not sample.

light.what: the light theme, the OS preference a reader with no stored choice follows (09 S9)

forced-colors.what: Windows High Contrast: chips and badges keep their glyph and text, no state rests on background-color alone (09 S8.5)

contrast-more.what: prefers-contrast: more: borders promote to --c-ink-muted, subtle fills drop to --c-bg, chip grounds become outlines (09 S8.5)

standard.about: WCAG 2.2 Level AA (09 S8). axe-core runs every rule tagged with a WCAG 2.0, 2.1 or 2.2 A or AA criterion; a violation is a rule it reports as failed, not one it leaves for review. pa11y runs its default runner, HTML_CodeSniffer, at its WCAG2AA standard (the criteria of WCAG 2.1 it implements; it has none of 2.2's), and a violation is an issue of type error, not a warning or a notice.
